description: Add WYSIWYG HTML editing to your WPF application, with MVVM binding, Word paste, spell checking and HTML source editing. Supports .NET 10 and .NET Framework 4.5+.
releaseNotes: Fixed the outer portion of image resize handles on high-DPI displays. Sizing handles now follow display scaling independently of document zoom, so dragging anywhere on a handle consistently resizes the image. Native Undo/Redo and saved image markup are preserved. No public API changes.
title: SpiceLogic WPF HTML Editor Control
